Package software.amazon.smithy.model.traits

Interface ResourceBinding

All Superinterfaces:
ToNode
All Known Implementing Classes:
ResourceDeletionBinding, ResourceLifecycleBinding
public interface ResourceBinding extends ToNode
Common surface shared by the binding structures of the resource lifecycle traits: every binding names an affected resource and may declare where to find that resource's identifiers.

ResourceLifecycleBinding adds property location for the create, put, read, and update traits; ResourceDeletionBinding omits properties because a resource is deleted by its identifiers alone.
